value.produces: hpuxvue-golden.qcow2 + checkpoint (HP-UX 10.20 -> HP VUE desktop over Artist fb, 1280x1024)

value.kbd_note: hpterm from File Manager Directory>Terminal (Ctrl+T); VUE front panel is the mouse proof
value.note: relative LASI PS/2 pointer, cursor_scale 1.0 (xset m 1 1 baked into the session). Foreign-arch TCG station on /opt/qemu-hppa (kernel-hive fork), like macos753. No network exec channel, but a serial console getty on tty1p0 gives a root shell on serve/serial.sock (docs/lab/retronet/WEB-STATION-hpuxvue.md).

labctl.notes: No exec channel yet: /dev/tty0p0 exists in the guest and QEMU exposes it on serial.sock in the station dir; wire a getty (inittab) + a serialcon-style client to get labctl exec. Until then drive it via QMP sendkey/mouse_move against a CLONE.

render.stationsManifestPrelude:
# hpuxvue (slot 144) — HP-UX 10.20 / HP VUE on a PA-RISC HP 9000/778 (B160L):
#   qemu-system-hppa from the kernel-hive QEMU fork, installed to /opt/qemu-hppa
#   (pve-qemu ships no hppa target). TCG only, no KVM. Artist framebuffer
#   scanout at 1280x1024 (HARD ceiling: higher crashes / dtwm pointer dead zone).
#   RELATIVE LASI PS/2 pointer (dbus-rel). DARK LAUNCH: listing=hidden while
#   the install runs on camera; SH_IDLE_PAUSE_SECS=0 until the golden exists.

deviceSetSummary: -drive if=scsi,bus=0,index=2,media=cdrom,file=$A/disc1.iso (always attached; -boot d only in the install shape)

launcherParity.reason: tracked verbatim launcher IS the deployed launcher; the golden checkpoint was baked 2026-08-18 with this exact device set (CD attached, same ISO) on the standalone /opt/qemu-hppa build

reset.fixture: HP VUE 3.0 desktop as root on HP-UX 10.20 at 1280x1024x8 (HP 9000/778 B160L under TCG), ON THE RETRONET: front panel with six workspaces, Helpview 'Welcome to Your HP Workstation!', a File Manager on / whose first item is the `Mosaic` launcher icon, and **NCSA X Mosaic 2.7b5 open on http://spacejam.com/**, served by the retronet gateway with no proxy configured. lan0 is up on 10.99.0.20 with no default route. Pointer 1:1 via `xset m 1 1` (applied into the live session before the bake; /.vue/sessionetc carries it but does not take effect on this login path). Keyboard PASS; mouse left to the operator's browser eyeball. Golden re-baked 2026-08-23 15:18 after the slirp->tap swap forced a cold rebuild.

museum.blurb: HP’s own Visual User Environment — the Motif desktop that CDE was built from — on the PA-RISC workstation Unix of the HP 9000 line.
museum.notes: Second non-CDE Motif workstation desktop in the hall (HP VUE 3.0 — what CDE was derived from); PA-RISC under TCG on a standalone qemu-system-hppa build.

network.note: retronet web plane: the tulip is a REAL bridged NIC on vmbr-rn via the persistent tap hpuxrn0 (streamhost/stations/hpuxvue/rn-tapnet.sh), MAC RN_HPUXVUE_MAC, HP-UX driver btlan3 as lan0. Addressed 10.99.0.20/24 with DNS 10.99.0.2 and NO default gateway — static, not DHCP, because the June-1996 dhcpclient cannot enumerate the btlan3 PPA (docs/lab/retronet/WEB-STATION-hpuxvue.md). Contained by the fail-closed HPUXRN-IN chain: reaches the gateway CT only, never labhost, the LAN or the internet.
